votes.motion: Approve the 21 May Street septic variance (sieve analysis and tank offset) without a FAST or JET system requirement, but with testing of all wells within 100 feet.
votes.quote: on motion by passios and second by fortin, the variance was approved without the requirement for use of a fast or jet system but with the requirement that all wells within 100 feet be tested.

votes.motion: Approve the 1024/1034/1048 Northfield Road variances, with the requirement that the forced mains be self-draining and buried deep enough to prevent freezing.
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by passios the variances were approved with the requirement that the proposed forced mains are self-draining

votes.motion: Approve the request to move the septic tank at 126 Youngs Road ten feet closer to the well (additional variance).
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the request was approved. all in favor.
